changelog: Initial release of Flasor with complete GUI and CLI support
Bootable USB creation from ISO files
Persistent storage setup for supported ISOs
File system selection: FAT32, NTFS, exFAT
Safety checks to prevent accidental system drive overwrite
Dark and Light themes with auto toggle
Live log viewer for write/format/partition logs
About and Help tabs with CLI/GUI guide and version info
Secure Boot support and bypass guidance
USB bad blocks scanning before writing
ISO compatibility check with warning system
Windows To Go support for Windows ISOs
